niche_preference_profile: Prefers light, high-contrast, spacious interfaces with clear structure, soft rounded shapes, concise copy, and low visual noise. They consistently favor breathable layouts, strong hierarchy, simple controls, and minimal decorative treatment over dark, crowded, overly explained, or heavily outlined designs.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light or neutral backgrounds with dark, legible text and avoids dark, low-contrast screens.
Prefers more whitespace, breathable content blocks, fewer text lines, and less crowded spacing.
Prefers clearly separated sections, aligned card-based grouping, and strong title-first information hierarchy.
Prefers pill-shaped or softly rounded buttons, cards, panels, and controls over sharper rectangular forms.
Prefers cleaner screens with fewer decorative overlays, lighter backgrounds, and less busy composition.
Prefers shorter supporting text, simpler titles, and less explanatory helper copy.
Prefers simpler, lower-emphasis controls with minimal borders or ornament, and clearer primary/secondary action treatment.

llm_analysis.why_user_chose_winner: Cleaner, more structured layout with balanced color blocks and simpler controls.
